snippet.title: Brawlers Tavern – Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Tavern!
Brawlers Tavern is a 2D PvP brawler where Zeldalike combat meets Mario Party-style mini-games.

Dive into ranked arenas, join mini-games, quest with friends, wage guild wars, or just kick back in the tavern. Whether you're here to brawl or banter, the tavern is always open!

Note: Everything shown is from an in-development build.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3513320/Brawlers_Tavern/?utm_source=youtube&utm_content=gameplay-reveal-trailer
